Headline: #97 Skokie buses Temporary Reroute at Niles Center Road/Madison
ShortDescription: #97 Skokie buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to fire department activity near Niles Center Road/Madison.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#97 Skokie buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Oakton, Skokie, Main, Niles Center Road, and over the normal route, due to fire department activity near Niles Center Road/Madison.

Allow extra travel time.
